full_judgment: 2. Opposite party Nos. 1-4 filed the suit for partition of ejmali property described in schedules Ka to Uma of the plaint. The defendants did not file any written statement. On 29-4-77 the present petitioners and opposite party Nos. 5 to 8 (who were defendants 11 to 14) and the plaintiffs filed a compromise petition with a prayer to pass a preliminary decree according to shares as shown in the compromise petition. Accordingly preliminary decree was passed in terms of compromise on 4-5-77. According to preliminary decree the plaintiffs were allotted 0.44 acres land out of 2.22 acres in GS Khatian Nos. 131, 264, 329 and 271. The share of the plaintiffs is 3 annas 4 ganda and 14 til. Plaintiff also were allotted 0.44 acres in Khatian Nos. 259 and 58, the share being 1 anna 11 ganda 7 til. So far the lands in Kha, Ga and Gha schedules are concerned the plaintiffs have not been given any share. Defendant Nos. 1-10 ie the present petitioners were given the lands of schedule Kha, Ga and Gha. The share of the defendants 1-10 was 1 anna 2 ganda 2 kantanti 14 til. Plaintiffs again have been allotted 7-22 acres in Uma schedule. Their share being 9 annas 10 ganda. But after preliminary decree there were certain transfers by registered deeds between the parties, plaintiffs 1-4 sold 57½ acres out of their 0.97 acres of land from plots 75, 1099 and 758/1141 from Uma schedule to defendants 50-52 by registered kabala dated 14-5-79. Plaintiff 1 sold 0.26 acres land from Ka schedule to defendants 3-6 on 29-4-77. The plaintiffs also sold 1.35 acres on the same date to defendants 3-6 from Uma schedule land. Plaintiff 2 sold 0.04 acres from ka schedule and 0.85 from Uma schedule 1 and on 29-4-77 to defendants 3-6. Plaintiff 3 on 29-4-77 sold 0.04 acre from Ka schedule land and 0.42 acres from Uma schedule land to defendants 3-6. Plaintiffs 1-4. sold. 57½ acres land out of their 0.978 acres of land from plot No. 751, 1099 and 758/1141 from Uma schedule land by registered kabala dated 14-5-79 to defendant 50-52. Defendant 51 sold 0.21 acres land from the said plot to defendant 3 on 5-6-85 by registered kabala. He also sold 0.10 acres land from plot No. 1161 to the defendant No. 4 on 10-2-90 by a registered kabala. In the said manner defendants 1-10 claimed to have inherited 0.27 acres and purchased 0.34 acres in Ka schedule land and they inherited 2.54 acres and purchased 2.62 in Uma schedule land. It is worthy to note that some transfers which were made even before the preliminary decree were also not brought to the notice of the trial Court at the time of passing the preliminary decree for incorporating in the petition of compromise and, as such, those lost consideration of the trial Court at the time of passing the preliminary decree. Final decree has not yet been passed or drawn up in this case.
